# SmartCredit.io Examples

Python examples for the SmartCredit Aave Liquidation Monitor MCP — real-time liquidation risk
intelligence for Aave V3 borrower positions on Ethereum mainnet, via Claude agents or direct
MCP calls. Also includes a standalone Aave V3 active positions fetcher.

Links: https://smartcredit.io · https://twitter.com/smartcredit_io · https://t.me/SmartCredit_Community
       https://smartcredit.io/learn
MCP repo: https://github.com/SmartCredit-io/web3-borrow-lend-mcp

Platform: Fixed-term fixed-interest DeFi loans · Personal fixed income funds · Fixed-rate
leveraged Lido staking · ~20,000 registered users · Self-custodial, regulatory-compliant

---

## MCP Server

URL: https://mcp.smartcredit.io/web3-borrow-lend-mcp
Transport: Anthropic managed MCP (betas=["mcp-client-2025-04-04"])
Auth: Public — no API key required
Network: Ethereum mainnet (Aave V3)

### MCP Tools

get_liquidation_risk    Real-time liquidation risk for an Aave V3 borrower address.
                        Returns: health factor, liquidation probability, risk tier,
                        per-asset collateral/debt positions, and threshold prices.

check_api_health        Ping the MCP server to confirm it is reachable.

### Risk Tiers

Safe        0–5%   liquidation probability — no action needed
Watch       5–15%  — monitor closely
Warning     15–35% — consider reducing exposure
Danger      35–70% — reduce position urgently
Critical    70–100% — immediate action required
Liquidatable HF < 1.0 — position is liquidatable now

---

## Repository Structure

python/smartcredit.py               Shared helper — imported by ALL example scripts
python/agents/                      Agent-based examples (6 scripts)
python/MCP/                         Direct MCP examples (2 scripts)
python/scripts/run_all_examples.py  Run all examples sequentially with summary table
python/scripts/aave_positions/      Standalone Aave V3 active positions fetcher (CLI)
.claude/agents/                     6 agent definitions from web3-borrow-lend-mcp repo
requirements.txt                    anthropic>=0.40.0, web3>=6.0.0, python-dotenv, requests
.env.example                        Copy to .env and set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY

---

## Shared Helper: python/smartcredit.py

Uses the Anthropic managed MCP beta (client.beta.messages.create with betas=["mcp-client-2025-04-04"]).
Unlike the SSE/streamable-HTTP helpers in other projects, this is a single blocking call —
no persistent connection, no background thread.

MCP_SERVER = {
    "type": "url",
    "url": "https://mcp.smartcredit.io/web3-borrow-lend-mcp",
    "name": "smartcredit-aave-liquidation-monitor",
}

Public function:

run(prompt, system=None, model="claude-haiku-4-5-20251001", max_tokens=4096) -> str
  Calls Claude with the SmartCredit MCP tools available via Anthropic's managed MCP beta.
  Pass system to override with an agent definition body.

sys.path setup required in scripts in python/agents/ and python/MCP/:
  sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), ".."))
  import smartcredit

---

## Two Example Patterns

### Agent-based (python/agents/)

The .md agent definition from .claude/agents/ is loaded as the system prompt. Tool
selection and output format are defined in the .md, not in code.

Pattern:
1. Load .claude/agents/<name>.md
2. Split on "---" to extract frontmatter and body (system prompt)
3. Parse `model:` from frontmatter; default to claude-haiku-4-5-20251001
4. Pass minimal user message (address + optional params — no API key needed)
5. Call smartcredit.run(user_message, system=system_prompt, model=model)

Note: load_agent() returns (model, body) — only 2 values, unlike ChainAware/SolPortfolio
which also return the raw frontmatter string.

  def load_agent(path: str) -> tuple[str, str]:
      with open(path) as f:
          content = f.read()
      parts = content.split("---", 2)
      frontmatter = parts[1] if len(parts) >= 3 else ""
      body = parts[2].strip() if len(parts) >= 3 else content.strip()
      m = re.search(r"^model:\s*(.+)$", frontmatter, re.MULTILINE)
      model = m.group(1).strip() if m else "claude-haiku-4-5-20251001"
      return model, body

### Direct MCP (python/MCP/)

A plain user prompt with all MCP tools available — no system prompt, no tool filtering.

---

## Agent Definitions (.claude/agents/)

6 agent definitions — must not be hand-edited; come from the upstream repo.
All use tools: mcp__smartcredit-aave-liquidation-monitor__get_liquidation_risk

Refresh from GitHub:
  gh api repos/SmartCredit-io/web3-borrow-lend-mcp/contents/.claude/agents | python3 -c "
  import json, sys, base64, subprocess
  for f in json.load(sys.stdin):
      data = json.loads(subprocess.run(['gh', 'api', f['url']], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout)
      open(f'.claude/agents/{f[\"name\"]}', 'w').write(base64.b64decode(data['content']).decode())
      print('Updated', f['name'])
  "

---

## Agent Examples (python/agents/)

  liquidation_monitor.py   smartcredit-liquidation-monitor.md   Scannable risk report — HF, tier, thresholds
  health_advisor.py        smartcredit-health-advisor.md        Actionable advice to improve HF and reduce risk
  threshold_finder.py      smartcredit-threshold-finder.md      Per-asset liquidation price thresholds by proximity
  stress_tester.py         smartcredit-stress-tester.md         Risk matrix across 7/14/30/90-day horizons
  portfolio_scanner.py     smartcredit-portfolio-scanner.md     Batch scan multiple positions, ranked by risk
  risk_reporter.py         smartcredit-risk-reporter.md         Full written risk report for docs or team sharing

portfolio_scanner.py accepts either multiple inline addresses or a CSV file.
CSV loader auto-detects column named address/wallet/Address/Wallet; falls back to first column.

---

## Direct MCP Examples (python/MCP/)

  health_check.py       check_api_health        Ping the MCP server
  liquidation_risk.py   get_liquidation_risk    Direct liquidation risk check for one address

---

## Running Examples

Run all commands from the project root.

  # agent examples — single address (demo address used if omitted)
  python python/agents/liquidation_monitor.py
  python python/agents/liquidation_monitor.py 0xd8dA6BF26964aF9D7eEd9e03E53415D37aA96045
  python python/agents/health_advisor.py 0xd8dA6BF26964aF9D7eEd9e03E53415D37aA96045
  python python/agents/threshold_finder.py 0xd8dA6BF26964aF9D7eEd9e03E53415D37aA96045
  python python/agents/stress_tester.py 0xd8dA6BF26964aF9D7eEd9e03E53415D37aA96045
  python python/agents/stress_tester.py 0xd8dA6BF26964aF9D7eEd9e03E53415D37aA96045 60  # 60-day sigma
  python python/agents/risk_reporter.py 0xd8dA6BF26964aF9D7eEd9e03E53415D37aA96045
  python python/agents/risk_reporter.py 0xd8dA6BF26964aF9D7eEd9e03E53415D37aA96045 14 60

  # portfolio scan
  python python/agents/portfolio_scanner.py wallets.csv
  python python/agents/portfolio_scanner.py 0xABC... 0xDEF... 0xGHI...

  # direct MCP
  python python/MCP/health_check.py
  python python/MCP/liquidation_risk.py
  python python/MCP/liquidation_risk.py 0xd8dA6BF26964aF9D7eEd9e03E53415D37aA96045

  # run all examples
  python python/scripts/run_all_examples.py

## Setup

  pip install -r requirements.txt
  cp .env.example .env
  # edit .env: set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
  # also set ETHERSCAN_API_KEY and RPC_URL if using the aave_positions fetcher

Environment variables:
  ANTHROPIC_API_KEY      Required — your Anthropic API key
  SMARTCREDIT_MCP_URL    Optional — override for local dev
  ETHERSCAN_API_KEY      Required for aave_positions fetcher (free tier sufficient)
  RPC_URL                Required for aave_positions fetcher (e.g. https://ethereum.publicnode.com)

---

## Aave V3 Active Positions Fetcher (python/scripts/aave_positions/)

Standalone CLI tool — independent of the MCP examples above. Scans Ethereum mainnet
backwards from the latest block using Etherscan getLogs, validates each borrower via
on-chain eth_call, stops when --limit active positions are found.

Aave V3 contracts (Ethereum mainnet):
  POOL_ADDRESS          0x87870Bca3F3fD6335C3F4ce8392D69350B4fA4E2
  DATA_PROVIDER_ADDRESS 0x7B4EB56E7CD4b454BA8ff71E4518426369a138a3
  V3_DEPLOY_BLOCK       16291127
  BORROW_TOPIC          keccak256("Borrow(address,address,address,uint256,uint8,uint256,uint16)")
                        Always use Web3.to_hex() — not .hex() — to guarantee 0x prefix.

Module layout:
  main.py       Entry point — arg parsing, scan loop, export
  config.py     Constants, Web3 setup, Etherscan rate limiter, date_to_block()
  fetcher.py    LogFetcher — Etherscan getLogs pagination with chunk splitting
  validator.py  PositionValidator — calls getUserAccountData, filters by debt/HF
  enricher.py   PositionEnricher — per-asset breakdown (--enrich flag)
  exporter.py   Exporter — writes CSV + JSON with timestamped filenames

Rate limiter: sliding-window deque(maxlen=3) of timestamps — sleeps when 3 calls
made within 1 second. All Etherscan calls must go through etherscan_get() in config.py.

Output: two files per run in python/scripts/aave_positions/output/, named:
  active_positions_limit{N}_{YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS}.csv/.json

CSV columns: address, health_factor, total_debt_usd, total_collateral_usd, ltv,
             available_borrow_usd (+ borrowed_assets, collateral_assets with --enrich)

CLI parameters:
  --limit        Stop after N active positions (default 100)
  --min-debt     Minimum total debt in USD (default 0)
  --max-hf       Maximum health factor, e.g. 1.5 = at-risk only (default 999)
  --asset        Filter by borrowed asset symbol, e.g. USDC (requires --enrich)
  --enrich       Add per-asset breakdown to output
  --chunk-size   Blocks per Etherscan getLogs call (default 2000)
  --csv          CSV output path (default: auto-named)
  --end-block    Block to start scanning backwards from (default: latest)
  --floor-block  Oldest block to scan back to (default: 16291127)

  python python/scripts/aave_positions/main.py --limit 10
  python python/scripts/aave_positions/main.py --limit 50 --min-debt 10000 --max-hf 1.5
  python python/scripts/aave_positions/main.py --limit 10 --enrich --asset USDC
  python python/scripts/aave_positions/main.py --limit 100 --csv /tmp/borrowers.csv

---

## Claude Code Setup

Register the MCP server in Claude Code:

  claude mcp add --transport http smartcredit-aave-liquidation-monitor \
    https://mcp.smartcredit.io/web3-borrow-lend-mcp

Copy agent definitions into your project:

  cp .claude/agents/smartcredit-*.md your-project/.claude/agents/
